per_question_results.question: In non‑strict mode, what is the value of this inside an arrow function defined inside an object method?
per_question_results.feedback: Arrow functions capture the this value from their surrounding lexical scope, not from how they are called.

per_question_results.question: Which statement about JavaScript closures is FALSE?
per_question_results.user_answer: Closures cannot be passed as arguments to other functions.
per_question_results.feedback: Closures are first‑class values and can be passed around like any other function.

per_question_results.question: How can you catch errors from an async function when using async/await?
per_question_results.user_answer: Check the return value for null.
per_question_results.feedback: A try…catch surrounding the await expression captures any rejection thrown by the async function.

javascript.overview: This roadmap guides a beginner from core JavaScript fundamentals to deeper mastery of context, prototypes, asynchronous patterns, and the event loop, with early focus on the student's weaker areas while reinforcing existing strengths.

modules.title: Core Foundations Refresher
modules.description: Quickly review essential syntax, data types, functions, and closures to ensure a solid base before tackling advanced topics.

topics.name: Variables, Data Types, and Scope
resources: official docs section on variables and types
topics.practice_prompt: Create a script that declares variables of different primitive types, manipulates them, and logs the results, demonstrating block vs function scope.

topics.name: Functions and Parameter Handling
topics.practice_prompt: Write a function that accepts a variable number of arguments, returns their sum, and test it with both regular calls and using the spread operator.

topics.name: Closures (quick reinforcement)
topics.practice_prompt: Implement a counter factory that returns an object with increment and decrement methods, each preserving its own private count.

modules.title: Understanding "this" and Context
modules.description: Deep dive into how JavaScript determines the value of `this` in different invocation patterns.

topics.name: Global and Function Context
topics.practice_prompt: Log the value of `this` inside a regular function called in the global scope, inside a strict‑mode function, and inside a function invoked with `new`.

topics.name: Method Invocation and Implicit Binding
resources: official docs section on method calls
topics.practice_prompt: Create an object with a method that uses `this` to reference its own properties, then call the method directly and via a detached reference to observe the binding change.

topics.name: Arrow Functions and Lexical `this`
resources: official docs section on arrow functions
topics.practice_prompt: Rewrite a regular function that loses its `this` context when used as a callback into an arrow function, and verify that `this` now refers to the surrounding object.

topics.name: Explicit Binding with call, apply, and bind
topics.practice_prompt: Define a standalone function that logs a property from `this`. Use `call`, `apply`, and `bind` to invoke it with different objects and observe the output.

modules.title: Prototypes and Inheritance
modules.description: Learn how JavaScript's prototype chain works and how to build inheritance patterns using both classic and ES6 syntax.

topics.name: Prototype Chain Basics
topics.practice_prompt: Create an object, add a property to its prototype, and demonstrate that the property is accessible through the original object.

topics.name: Object.create and Direct Prototype Assignment
topics.practice_prompt: Use `Object.create` to build a hierarchy of three objects, each inheriting from the previous, and verify property lookup at each level.

topics.name: ES6 Classes and Prototype Relationship
topics.practice_prompt: Define a class with a constructor and a method, instantiate it, then inspect its prototype to show where the method resides.

topics.name: Inheritance with extends and super
resources: official docs section on class inheritance
topics.practice_prompt: Create a base class `Animal` with a method, extend it with a subclass `Dog` that overrides the method and calls `super`, then instantiate `Dog` and call the method.

modules.title: Asynchronous JavaScript: Promises and async/await
modules.description: Master modern asynchronous patterns, moving from callbacks to promises and the async/await syntax.

topics.name: Callback Patterns and Pitfalls
topics.practice_prompt: Write a function that reads two simulated files using nested callbacks, then refactor it to avoid deep nesting by using named functions.

topics.name: Promises Fundamentals
topics.practice_prompt: Create a promise that resolves after a random delay, chain `.then` handlers to transform the value, and add a `.catch` to handle rejection.

topics.name: Async/Await Syntax and Error Handling
resources: official docs section on async functions
topics.practice_prompt: Rewrite the promise chain from the previous topic using `async`/`await`, include `try/catch` blocks, and test it with both resolved and rejected scenarios.

topics.name: Real‑World Async: Fetch API and Parallel Requests
resources: official docs section on Fetch API
topics.practice_prompt: Fetch data from two public JSON endpoints concurrently using `Promise.all`, then display combined results in the console.

modules.title: Event Loop and Concurrency Model
modules.description: Explore how JavaScript schedules tasks, handles microtasks, and manages the call stack to write non‑blocking code.

topics.name: Call Stack, Task Queue, and Microtasks
resources: official docs section on event loop
topics.practice_prompt: Log messages from a synchronous function, a `setTimeout`, a resolved promise, and a `process.nextTick` (or equivalent) to observe execution order.

topics.name: Event Loop Mechanics in the Browser
resources: official docs section on event loop
topics.practice_prompt: Create a page with a button that triggers a heavy computation, a `setTimeout`, and a promise, then measure UI responsiveness.

topics.name: Timing Functions and Their Interaction with Async Code
topics.practice_prompt: Implement a debounced search input that waits 300ms after the last keystroke before invoking an async fetch.

topics.name: Performance Considerations and Avoiding Blocking
topics.practice_prompt: Refactor a CPU‑intensive loop to run in chunks using `setImmediate`/`setTimeout` and report the time saved compared to the blocking version.
